prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2:1 equirectangular Three.js environment background for a high-fidelity PC mythic-creature viewer
Primary request: Create an empty ancient southern wilderness after a storm, a rain-dark elevated stone terrace overlooking distant floodplains and layered mountains, suitable as the habitat of Yinglong, the Chinese winged rain dragon.
Scene/backdrop: dark teal wet rock platform across the lower foreground; shallow reflective puddles; low broken stone forms and a few distant wind-bent ancient trees; broad misty marsh and mountain silhouettes at the horizon; receding rain curtains under heavy low clouds; one restrained warm-gold break in the cloud cover.
Subject: environment only. Absolutely no dragon, no creature, no people.
Style/medium: cinematic realistic fantasy environment, physically plausible materials, subtle Chinese ancient myth atmosphere, polished game-background quality, not a painting pasted on canvas.
Composition/framing: seamless-looking 2:1 equirectangular panorama; level horizon; keep the central foreground open and uncluttered for a moving 3D actor; no close foreground objects that could intersect the creature.
Lighting/mood: storm just ending at dusk, cool blue-green ambient light, faint warm rim from cloud break, restrained contrast so a dark green creature remains readable.
Color palette: rain-cloud gray, distant mountain teal, wet-rock near-black, muted warm gold.
Materials/textures: wet stone, thin water sheen, mist, soft rain haze, real surface variation.
Constraints: environment only; no text, no letters, no symbols, no watermark, no modern architecture, no temples, no weapons, no lightning bolt, no fire, no high-contrast clutter; panorama edges should not contain unique landmarks that make a seam obvious.
